Package io.jans.lock.model.trace.api

package io.jans.lock.model.trace.api
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ProducerChainListResponse
    Response body of the producer-chain listing admin endpoint (task 15).
    ProducerChainRegistrationRequest
    Admin request body to pre-register a producer chain (design §8, TRACE MVP design decision D-5, task 15).
    ProducerChainResponse
    A registered producer chain as returned by the admin API (design §8, T-3, task 15).
    ProducerKeyListResponse
    Response body of the producer-key listing admin endpoint (task 15).
    ProducerKeyRegistrationRequest
    Admin request body to register a producer's Ed25519 verification key (design §6, TRACE MVP task 15).
    ProducerKeyResponse
    A registered producer key as returned by the admin API.
    ProducerKeyRevokeRequest
    Admin request body to revoke a producer's Ed25519 verification key (design decision D-4, task 15).
    TraceAcceptanceResponse
    The POST /audit/trace success body (design §11.1, TRACE MVP task 20): the identity and receipt position the record was accepted at, plus the four ingestion flags fixed at ingestion time.
    TraceBulkIngestionResponse
    The POST /audit/trace/bulk response body (design decision D-16): one TraceBulkResultEntry per submitted array element, in request order.
    TraceBulkResultEntry
    One element of POST /audit/trace/bulk's results array (design decision D-16): the submitted array's position, whether that item was accepted, and either its acceptance body (TraceBulkResultEntry.getRecord()) or its structured error (TraceBulkResultEntry.getError()) — exactly one of the two is non-null.
    TraceErrorResponse
    Swagger schema for the structured TRACE error body (design decision D-10).
    TraceExecutionResponse
    The direct TRACE records of one execution, ordered by receipt sequence (design §10, §11.3, TRACE MVP task 21).
    TraceIngestionResponse
    The ingestion member of a TRACE record envelope (design §10, TRACE MVP task 21): the receipt-chain position and the four Lock-derived flags (design decision D-9, eventually consistent).
    TraceRecordResponse
    A single TRACE record envelope (design §10, §11.2, TRACE MVP task 21): the stored assertion plus the verification outcome and the Lock-derived ingestion metadata.
    TraceVerificationResponse
    The verification member of a TRACE record envelope (design §10, TRACE MVP task 21).
